text: Shell scripts invoke the hidden `__complete` command, or `__completeNoDesc` when descriptions are unwanted (`completions.go:26-33`; `powershell_completions.go:34-37`). The hidden command's `Run` function dispatches the supplied command line to `cmd.getCompletions(args)`, receiving the final command, choices, directive, and any error (`completions.go:202-213`).
